title: Story premise EDU018: The Bent Straw Detective
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (everyday science). Hook: Did the straw bend, or did the light change direction? Takeaway/theme: Refraction can change the apparent position of a submerged object.
description: An illustrator wants to draw a straw crossing a water surface, but a straight copied line misses its apparent bend. A ray overlay distinguishes the physical straw from the changing path of light.
